text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Synthetic monitor alert: apac-canary-http-5xx rate > 7% (detected at 02:09 UTC). Paging oncall.
alice_sre: i'll take pager, grabbing context. any cluster/route hints?
samir_platform: seeing 502s from apac-edge-green pods only. recent deploy of runtime image v2.1-green at 02:02. logs show repeated errors:
```
2026-03-17T02:08:55Z ERROR model-server kv_cache: schema mismatch expected=0x03 found=0x04
2026-03-17T02:09:01Z WARN http service request id=abc123 upstream=502
```
jessica_runtime: we enabled a new feature-flag 'kv-prewarm' in the green rollout to improve cold-start latency. canary target was 5% but looks like routing weights drifted.
alice_sre: confirmed via router API: `redwood-routerctl get-weights --region apac` returns `blue=70 green=30` — that is higher than the intended 5% canary.
samir_platform: that explains it. green had an incompatible prewarm path. mitigation plan: 1) kill flag for green, 2) reduce green weight to 0, 3) rollback image if needed. executing step 1 now.
jessica_runtime: ack — if kill works we should see errors drop in <2m. if not, proceed to weight flip.
samir_platform: running `ffctl set --env=green kv-prewarm false --note "emergency kill: apac 502 spikes"`
incidents-bot: Action logged by samir_platform: feature flag kv-prewarm set to false (env=green) — tracking.
alice_sre: errors dropping to ~1.2% in APAC (pre: ~8.4%). continuing to monitor. prepare to flip weights if it doesn't trend down.
maria_support: heads-up to support: partial APAC customer impact. drafting outbound for impacted tenants (APAC regional tenants only). ETA 10m.
samir_platform: errors plateauing; still seeing some 502s from older pods. flipping weights now: `redwood-routerctl set-weight --region apac blue=100 green=0 --author samir_platform`
incidents-bot: Router weight change recorded: apac blue=100 green=0.
alice_sre: immediate drop to baseline 0.2% 5xx. :white_check_mark: Good — customer impact window ~02:07-02:13 UTC.
jessica_runtime: i'm initiating a rollback of the green image to v2.0 and will re-run the canary with stricter routing. `kubectl -n runtime rollout undo deployment/model-server -o name --to-revision=v2.0` (will follow up in PR).
samir_oncall: taking post-incident followup. i'll capture exact traffic numbers and confirm if any persisted cache corruption needs cleanup. handing pager to samir_platform for morning ops; ops-handoff-bot: handoff recorded.
alice_sre: handing off to samir_platform, thanks team. summary for postmortem: cause = feature-flag gated kv-prewarm incompatible with deployed cache schema + routing weight drift in APAC caused higher-than-intended canary exposure. mitigation = emergency FF kill, router weight flip, image rollback. impact = elevated 5xx for APAC tenants ~6 minutes, estimated ~1.8k failed requests/min peak, subset of customers in APAC (~0.8% of active users) saw errors.
maria_support: support outbound queued to send now; will include timeline + mitigation + ETA for follow-up. assigning follow-up action: tag affected accounts and offer direct contact for any SLA concerns.
jessica_runtime: creating hotfix PR to add validation to canary router controller and a guard in FF service to prevent flag enable if cache-schema mismatch detected. will link PR in the postmortem.
ops-handoff-bot: Handoff complete. Post-incident ticket #INC-APAC-431210 in triage. Owners: samir_platform (postmortem), jessica_runtime (fix), maria_support (customer comms).
